name: Princess of Sky

features.name: Ruby heart wild
features.description: Substitutes for all symbols except scatters.

review:
Princess of Sky is a 2016 BGaming slot with nine lines and a ruby heart as the wild, which substitutes for every symbol except scatters.

Three, four or five scatters trigger 10, 20 or 50 free spins, and the round can be retriggered, a generous structure for such an old game. Free spins are very frequent, arriving about once every 51 spins on average. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 2,649x maximum and a 95.99% RTP. A nice option if you like bonus-heavy sessions.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 51 spins on average)
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
